title: Choose another brand
text: Choose another brand. The color was perfect.  However,  the tissue box was twisted so out of shape that I couldn't use it.  It also does not fit the size of an American tissue box

product_metadata.title: KOUBOO 1030018 Rectangular Tissue Box Cover, 10 Inch, Honey Brown
features: 10 Inch long x 6 Inch wide x 4.25 Inch high (Inside dimension 9 inches x 4.875 inches x 3.75 inches)
NOTE: Measure your tissue box to verify dimensions
Finished with a coating of clear lacquer
description: A pretty accent for any room, this rattan tissue box cover is hand woven in Hapao style, which refers to the technique of alternating the color from a light natural to dark mocha when weaving the rattan peel over the rattan vine. This honey-brown rattan tissue box cover holds a standard rectangular-sized tissue box. Caution: Not all tissue boxes are created equal. Please measure the tissue boxes you are using and compare with the measurements of the tissue box cover hereafter to verify that the one will fit into the other.
